relevant government legislation but which the general provisions of the constitution may apply

and where 19 (a) of the Land Acquisition Act above especially the latter part of (a) may

specifically apply or construe to apply; if these are deemed divergent, they are not onerous and

can be built into the meaning and application 19 (a) of the Acquisition Act, and detailed and

costed as part of the "Implementation Process" in 4.1 below or as part of the "Plan of Action" to

be developed which will outline measures to assist displaced persons experiencing losses or

hardships associated with the project. In case of divergence between the Government laws and

Bank Policy - Bank policy applies.
